objective: Close the P3-001 pre-ready shutdown lifecycle defect in the bundled browser worker. The worker currently starts reading shutdown commands only after Chromium reaches CDP readiness and the ready record is emitted; if the Dart supervisor times out during Chromium startup/connect and terminates the Node worker, the detached Chromium process group can outlive the worker. Make shutdown observable during startup, race startup/connect against that shutdown signal, and guarantee the existing browser-tree cleanup path runs before process exit. Preserve normal ready/shutdown behavior and P3-002 session boundaries.
requiredTests: pre-ready shutdown interrupts a pending startup operation
normal ready then shutdown remains successful
cleanup retains primary startup failure plus cleanup evidence
